senses.gloss: --a commander of भण्ड to aid विषङ्ग; killed by भगमाला. Br. IV. २१. ७८; २५. २७. ९४.

--(Saunahotra and प्रकाशिरट्)--the son of काश (राष्ट्र वि। प्।) and the king of काशि; see काशिप;
1: Br. III. ६७. 7. Vi. IV. 8. 7-8.
a मन्त्रकृत् and of the Angirasa branch.
2: वा. ५९. १०२.
Performed penance for sons on account of which Arjadeva Dhanvantri became his son; father of Dharma and Dhanvantri.
3: Ib. ९२. 6, १८-19.
(I)--a son of रष्ट्र and father of Dhan- vantari. भा. IX. १७. 4.
(IV)--a son of Utathya and ममता; father of Anga and others. Half-brother of भरद्वाज. Vi. IV. १८. १३; १९. १६.
(I)--a son of खट्वान्ग (Dilipa) and father of Raghu. भा. IX. १०. 1; Br. III. ६३. १८३; वा. ८८. १८३; Vi. IV. 4. ८३-4. [page२-098+ २७]
